close_reason: Committed as 1991215: WsSender/WsReceiver/WsSession now assert Send + Sync
description: The WsSession split (commit d0ca9c4) added compile-time Send assertions for WsSender and WsReceiver but omitted Sync assertions. The types are intended to be shared across tasks (WsSender behind Arc for concurrent sends). Without Sync, Arc<WsSender> cannot be sent across threads. The current tungstenite-backed implementation is likely Sync in practice (the inner type is SplitSink which is Sync when the underlying stream is), but the assertion would catch a future backend change that breaks the contract. Fix: add fn assert_sync<T: Sync>() {} and assert_sync::<WsSender>(); assert_sync::<WsReceiver>(); alongside the existing Send assertions at crate-jmap-base-client/src/ws/mod.rs:895-910.
title: WsSender/WsReceiver missing Sync compile-time assertion
